protocol.source_text: General procedure  B  was  applied to  7-methoxy-2-methylquinoline  (173 mg,  1.00mmol).  The  reaction  was stirred  at  room  temperature  for  48  hours  affording  a  95:5  mixture  of  2  monoborylated  products  as determined  by  GC-MS.  Volatiles  were  removed  under  reduced  pressure  and  the  remaining  residue  was purified  by  silica  gel  flash-column  chromatography  with  gradient  elution  of  MeOH/DCM  from  0.5 -12.5% over    25    column    volumes,    affording    the major    7-methoxy-2-methyl-4-(4,4,5,5-tetramethyl-[1,3,2]-dioxaborolan-2-yl)quinolineproduct as a pale yellow solid (218 mg, 73%); m.p.87 -88 °C;
